_comment: Real building: P.S. 24 (X024), BBL 2059170140. Public: LL84 2024 grid kWh (226,605) and on-site solar generated (457,512 kWh), floor area and year built. The intake has no field for existing solar, so it is stated in the question. Not public (stated choices): budget, roof area (floor area / 3 floors), critical loads.
question: Our roof already has solar that made about 457,000 kWh last year, and we bought 226,605 kWh from the grid. How do we cut grid power another 30% by 2030 on $400k?
